scope: One fixed learned per-joint mixture for positions and valid rotations
calibration: Artificial frame zero in the existing corpus only; excluded from motion observations and targets
holdouts: Old and v19-added validation are both exposed development data. Freeze weights before loading either in this experiment. All gates pass independently on old/new/combined before any of the six sealed confirmation clips may open.
label_policy: Only four known poses (or two without context) enter observations; full targets are separate trainer labels
physics_policy: Collapsed semantic edges are not asserted to have constant length; raw baselines do not qualify actual rig physics
next: Evaluate selected compatible predictions on actual-rig editable actions; failed gates forbid promotion
selection: One prospectively fixed596-input,32-hidden,119-output joint mixture;40epochs and no grid or development retuning.
reproduction: Repeat complete gate fit and development evaluation. Model, parent membership, fixed feature audit, expert strengths and every non-runtime report must match exactly.
runtime: Local NumPy float64; previously bounded public data acquisition complete; no runtime downloads or external services
projection_method: Fixed 48-step projected Adam with eight bounded quarter-step backtracking attempts; exact root, terminal orientations and known priorities
fold_group: CMU catalog prefix before underscore, not asserted to be independent actor identity
objective: Equal-cohort full153-channel trajectory squared error with original velocity/acceleration weights; differentiate actual normalized-quaternion mixture.
architecture: Same596 observed curve inputs and32 shared tanh hidden units. Each of17 joints has four position and three rotation softmax weights (119outputs). Frozen v20 learned expert plus existing procedural experts; original v23 and all other candidates stay unchanged.
stationary_acceptance: Raw stationary pose retained within double-precision quaternion conversion roundoff; original actual-rig2e-5 tolerance unchanged.
control_policy: Retain original projected linear/Hermite and add projected shape reference. Every ratio and worst-cohort check compares against the best of all three; thresholds remain identical. This prevents procedural improvements from being presented as learned-motion gains.
rotation_policy: Convert linear/Hermite/v20 rotations to unit quaternions, align signs to the linear reference, use a normalized convex quaternion blend with fixed1e-6linear-reference mass to prevent zero norm. Differentiate through normalization and the rotation6 polynomial. Priority transforms are overwritten exactly. No claimed C1 continuity at hemisphere ambiguity.
fold_policy: Reconstruct the exact four v20 catalog-prefix folds. Each gate-training row uses the parent model excluding its whole catalog group. The gate itself sees all training labels; no nested cross-validation or independent gate-generalization claim.
guard_policy: Joint position weights are convex; proper rotations use hemisphere-aligned normalized quaternions. Neither property guarantees motion quality. Six confirmation clips remain sealed.
curve_features: At nine fixed normalized query times, summarize each expert versus linear using mean/max positional excursion, speed, acceleration, incoming/outgoing tangent mismatch and semantic-edge length deviation. Normalize by observed per-joint position amplitude or rest semantic-edge length, map zero denominators to zero, apply log1p. Descriptors are not physical guarantees or calibrated uncertainty probabilities.
feature_ownership: Calculate any parent-dependent descriptors with the exact group-excluded parent used for that row. No target or hidden-frame data enters descriptors. No new parent fits or input observations.
